BiblicalUsage: Sirah is the well from which Joab sends messengers to bring Abner back to Hebron, where Joab kills him. The name appears once, as the place of a murder dressed up as a summons. Abner walks back trusting the message, and the well is the last place of his peace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sirah shows how revenge dresses itself as business, and Joab's murder of Abner is the deed that stains his whole career.
